_meta.description: Registry of all DB::select/DB::statement/DB::unprepared and DB::table(DB::raw(...)) call sites in app/, excluding app/Support/Install (legacy install scripts). Source of truth for the CI 'Raw SQL ratchet' job and tests/Architecture/RawQueriesRegistryTest.php. Entries are matched by file+line: if a registered call site moves, update the 'line' field — drift fails the test loudly. To add a new raw query: get it reviewed and add an entry here.

queries.purpose: One-off upgrade: backfill snatched.hit_and_run_id from hit_and_runs via UPDATE ... INNER JOIN
queries.reason: Multi-table UPDATE ... INNER JOIN kept verbatim from the legacy upgrade script; rewriting it as a builder join-update would re-derive an already audited statement for a command that runs once

queries.purpose: One-off upgrade: copy torrents descr/technical_info/nfo into torrent_extras via INSERT ... SELECT with an ON DUPLICATE KEY upsert clause
queries.expected_index: torrent_extras key on torrent_id used by the upsert
queries.reason: INSERT ... SELECT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE with a generated upsert clause (Database::upsertField) has no query-builder equivalent

queries.purpose: One-off upgrade: ALTER TABLE torrents dropping the legacy text columns that were migrated to torrent_extras
queries.reason: DDL; the DROP COLUMN list is built dynamically from Schema::hasColumn() checks and issued as a single ALTER TABLE, which the schema builder cannot express conditionally in one statement

queries.purpose: One-off upgrade: backfill snatched.buy_log_id from torrent_buy_logs via UPDATE ... INNER JOIN
queries.reason: Multi-table UPDATE ... INNER JOIN kept verbatim from the legacy upgrade script; rewriting it as a builder join-update would re-derive an already audited statement for a command that runs once

queries.purpose: Disable foreign key checks before truncating all data tables (fresh-install/seed reset command)
queries.reason: Session-level SET statement, not table DML; the explicit off/on pair around the try/finally truncate loop is intentional for auditability

queries.purpose: Re-enable foreign key checks in the finally block after the truncate loop
queries.reason: Session-level SET statement, not table DML; must run unconditionally in finally even when truncation fails

queries.purpose: ALTER TABLE users AUTO_INCREMENT = <option> to reset the primary key counter for a fresh install
queries.reason: ALTER TABLE ... AUTO_INCREMENT is DDL with no schema-builder equivalent; the value is interpolated from the CLI option, not a bound parameter

queries.purpose: Archive expired iplog/login_logs rows into *_archive tables via INSERT ... SELECT with an added archived_at timestamp
queries.expected_index: Range scan on the retention date column (iplog.access / login_logs.created_at)
queries.reason: INSERT ... SELECT with a literal NOW() column appended cannot be expressed by the query builder (insertUsing cannot append expressions)

queries.purpose: Staff IP search: paginate a UNION of users and iplog matches wrapped as a derived table
queries.expected_index: n/a — INET_ATON() on the ip columns defeats index use; staff-only query
queries.reason: The query builder cannot use a UNION as a FROM source; the compiled union SQL is wrapped in DB::raw() and bindings are carried over via mergeBindings()

queries.purpose: Staff IP search: count DISTINCT user ids across the users/iplog union wrapped as a derived table
queries.expected_index: n/a — INET_ATON() on the ip columns defeats index use; staff-only query
queries.reason: The query builder cannot use a UNION as a FROM source; the compiled union SQL is wrapped in DB::raw() and bindings are carried over via mergeBindings()

queries.purpose: Read MySQL server status variables (SHOW STATUS) for the admin stats page
queries.reason: SHOW STATUS is a server administration statement, not table DML; there is no query-builder equivalent
